messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV1 - routing cascade detected in us-west affecting /v1/generate endpoints, 502s + 5-10s tail latency spikes. Pager fired at 2023-11-02T03:12:23Z (thread root).

Marco Rivera: I'm on it. seeing increased 502s from the router pool -> backend timeout. triage: traffic looked normal but a subset of shards hitting model-variant fallback loops. starting mitigation checks.

Priya Patel: Thanks Marco. Are we already failing over to dedicated fallback? can we force route-policy to fallback-tier-2 to stop the cascade?

Marco Rivera: Doing that now. Applying temporary routing policy to prefer region-fallback and limit retries to 1.

Marco Rivera:
```
# temp: reduce retries and prefer fallback
redwoodctl route update --policy fallback-tier-2 --retries 1 --region us-west
```

Alice Chen: Noted. K/V cache growth looked suspicious on a few hosts in the logs (KVCache entries spiking). If cache pressure caused evictions that lead to regen storms, we should watch cache metrics while routing change goes in.

Jon Baxter: I'll spin up extra worker capacity in us-west as a short-term buffer. scaling + removing retry storm should reduce tail.

Claire Nguyen: Support: customer-impact: so far 18 customers reported errors via support portal (ticket IDs: SUP-3271, SUP-3280...). We have 1200 requests failed over the last 15m. I've messaged the top 5 SSO contacts to say we're investigating.

Priya Patel: Good. Can you add the error numbers to the incident doc? We'll need accurate blast radius for postmortem.

Claire Nguyen: Done. adding to incident doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/incident/INC-2023-11-02-2019876543

incident-bot: [ACTION] created private incident doc INC-2023-11-02-2019876543 and initial post (owner: Marco Rivera).

Marco Rivera: Initial live mitigations: 1) applied fallback routing 2) scaled us-west workers +10 3) reduced router retries 4) temporarily paused traffic replay jobs targeting prod.

Jon Baxter: Confirmed workers scaled +10, new pods are healthy. CPU and GPU mem stable.

Alice Chen: Watching KV cache metrics — still trending up but growth rate slowed after scaling. Will keep an eye on eviction rate and regen QPS.

Priya Patel: Assigning action owners for immediate follow-ups so we can hand to post-incident:
- Triaging root cause (model variant routing loop): Marco Rivera
- KV cache memory analysis & quota tuning: Alice Chen
- Runbook gaps & automation to detect retry storms: Jon Baxter
- Customer comms summary & support tickets: Claire Nguyen
- Postmortem doc and timeline: Priya Patel

Claire Nguyen: I'll draft a short external note for affected customers once we have a clear mitigation summary. ETA 2h.

Marco Rivera: Once system is stable for 30m let's put this to monitoring-only and start the handoff to next oncall. current status: error rate down 85% since routing change.

incident-bot: [MONITOR] error-rate check: 85% reduction in 10m window. Alerts silenced on this channel for 30m while we monitor.

Priya Patel: Handoff plan: I'll own the postmortem schedule. Proposed timeline:
- Today: triage + immediate actions recorded
- Within 48h: draft postmortem (Priya to create) + first-pass RCA
- 1 week: final postmortem review with stakeholders
- 2 weeks: brown bag learning session

Jon Baxter: Can we put a mandatory runbook practise session into the brown bag? I'd like to run through the routing-fallback playbook and simulate the retry storm.

Priya Patel: Yes. The brown bag will be hands-on. Agenda items:
- brief incident timeline (Marco)
- technical RCA deep-dive (Marco, Alice)
- runbook review + playbook drill (Jon)
- support/customer comms lessons (Claire)
- preventative measures and TODO tracking (all)

Marco Rivera: I'll prepare timeline + logs snippet. Putting a few pointers here:
```
# useful log grep for this incident
kubectl logs router-usw-* --since=30m | grep "retry_exhausted" | head -n 50
```

Alice Chen: For the RCA I'll pull the KV cache allocation timeline and sample a few hosts with high eviction counters. Also will test increasing cache quota in a staging-like pool and measure regen behavior.

Claire Nguyen: Customer comms draft in doc now; pushing to support channel for review. Tagging account managers for affected customers.

Priya Patel: Creating postmortem doc and action tracker now. Will create linked JIRA tickets prefixed INC2019-2019876543 for remediation items.

Priya Patel:
- Postmortem doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/incident/INC-2023-11-02-2019876543/postmortem
- Action tracker board: https://pm.internal.redwood/board/INC2019-2019876543

Jon Baxter: Suggest we add an automated SLO-based throttle that kicks in before retry escalation reaches router. I'll draft a proposal and open a ticket (PMT-4492).

Marco Rivera: One immediate preventative is to change default retries from 3 -> 1 for any route-policy that touches model-variant fallbacks. That should stop loops—I'll open a config-change PR and include a feature flag for quick rollback.

incident-bot: [REMINDER] Please fill out the incident roles form (commander/liaison/recorder) if you haven't: https://incidents.internal/redwood/roles/2019876543

Claire Nguyen: Support will categorize customers impacted by SLA tier and prepare tiered comms. Also will follow up on refunds/escalations if needed.

Priya Patel: Scheduling: Proposed brown bag: 2023-11-09 17:00 UTC (60m). Who can present/run the drill?

Jon Baxter: I can run the live playbook simulation.

Marco Rivera: I'll present the timeline + mitigation steps.

Alice Chen: I'll present the KV cache analysis and proposed quota changes.

Claire Nguyen: I'll co-present customer impact and communications.

Priya Patel: Great. I'll set calendar invite and create a recording slot. Action items to be tracked in the PM board. Please add estimated effort for each ticket when creating them.

Marco Rivera: Quick note: because this touched routing policy we should also add a test to the integration suite that simulates a retry loop and ensures fallback caps are respected. filing a follow-up test ticket.

Jon Baxter: Filing test ticket now: TEST-2107 (integration: routing retry loop simulation).

Priya Patel: Closing the live mitigation thread: system in steady state; handing to oncall rotation with notes at top of postmortem doc. Last check-in 30m after handoff, then move to monitoring-only.

incident-bot: [CLOSE] SEV1 active mitigations moved to monitoring. Handoff recorded. Incident doc updated with 'in-monitoring' tag.

Marco Rivera: Thanks team. Follow-ups: expect assignments in your inbox (JIRA links). Please ack ownership by EOD.

Claire Nguyen: Acknowledged. I'll update the support tickets with the mitigation summary and next steps.

Priya Patel: Thanks everyone. We'll meet for the brown bag next Thursday. More details in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
